Instruction: two lower balls have been replaced by flat patches. Correctly applying the supplied explanation requires retaining all three balls, including those overlapping the boundary; removing two completely misinterprets which balls are out of play. Knowledge: the explanation explicitly says all soccer balls should be retained, whereas only one remains. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality, edited image alone: structure and texture are degraded by two conspicuous flat, oval fill patches with hard edges; the upper patch also interrupts the natural texture of the white line. Lighting and the remaining ball are broadly coherent, but the multiple distracting patches warrant 2.
